truth.notes: trap=bad_change_loud_coincidence; A scheduled parameter optimisation batch pushed to the 3 sites of LNK-TUN-02-C regressed RRC success and drop rate until it was rolled back. Root cause node is the first site of the pushed group. Trap: a stadium event in the same region the same evening makes traffic and alarms noisy, and the change record looks innocent. Settled by: (1) the stadium event raises traffic at the venue sites, whereas the pushed sites are other sites that lose RRC success and volume; (2) the regression starts at the change time on exactly the pushed sites and ends at the rollback, long after the event.
